purpose: Document local county parcel-map evidence, point jurisdiction and bounded anonymous geometry route review.
assessment: The WUP locator is in Minneapolis (not Saint Paul) and in Hennepin County. The existing Ramsey County/St Paul source therefore does not cover this point. Hennepin County parcel GIS returned no exact locator feature; two nearby features were returned from a 25 m extent and retained with only the county PIN and geometry. Hennepin metadata describes a tax parcel dataset that is not suitable for surveying/legal use.
registryAssessment: Hennepin County publishes local county parcel geometry maintained from Survey Division geometry and property tax records. Treat it as a local tax/assessor parcel fabric, not a title boundary or legal survey.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Minneapolis GIS page points users to City GIS, Open Data Minneapolis and City of Saint Paul GIS as separate resources.
Minnesota Geospatial Commons identifies the public Hennepin County County Parcels dataset, monthly refresh, and county PIN field; describes stacked multi-PID geometries.

Hennepin County metadata says parcel geometry is created and maintained by Hennepin County Survey Division, combined with county property-tax extracts, and is not suitable for legal, engineering or surveying use.
Metropolitan Council city-boundary layer used to identify exact WUP point as Minneapolis.
Metropolitan Council Hennepin County parcel layer queried with safe field allowlist only.
Official Hennepin County property page lists public property maps, survey plats and maps for download or purchase.

searchQueries.query: Minneapolis official parcel map property polygons city GIS open data
searchQueries.result: Found Minneapolis GIS/open-data guidance and Hennepin County public parcel data; exact locator is within Minneapolis and Hennepin County, while nearby polygons but no exact-point parcel were returned.
searchQueries.method: Separate English-language discovery search, official service metadata and bounded point/envelope requests.

serviceChecks.method: GET exact-point query with where=CTU_NAME=Minneapolis, outFields=CTU_NAME, returnGeometry=false

serviceChecks.observation: Hennepin County Parcels; Polygon; EPSG:26915; County PIN (`COUNTY_PIN`) is available. Other address/owner fields exist but were not requested.
Empty result at exact WUP point. First attempt used non-existent PID field and returned ArcGIS query error; retried after reading schema.

serviceChecks.method: GET 25 m EPSG:26915 envelope; outFields=OBJECTID,COUNTY_PIN; resultRecordCount=3; outSR=4326
serviceChecks.observation: Two features returned and retained; both are nearby, not exact-point matches.

privacy: Only county parcel identifiers and geometry were requested/retained. No owner, address, taxpayer, title or tax values were requested; no property lookup was submitted.

qualification.note: No city-wide qualification was performed; only exact point and 25 m near-point extent were queried.
